method: Manually reviewed all response candidates using exact native/frozen date and clocks, coordinates, region and source magnitude, then encoded explicit selection map; date/nearest-origin automatic selection prohibited. Raw source revision/compound restrictions remain explicit. No network or promotion performed.

geographic_identity_scope.decision: Historical NCEI geographic site identity may support a reviewed geographic-only relation after exact-event name, country/region and source coordinates are corroborated; no site identities promoted by this review.
limits: Coordinates in official help are the reported city/state/island location of effects, not proven precise historical gauge position.
Current COOPS candidates alone do not prove historical deployment or station continuity.
Retain NCEI runup record ID, event ID, source reference and coordinate precision/datum unknowns; resolve homonyms and harbor relocations manually.
Never infer instrument ID, historical deployment, UTC date, or target eligibility from geographic name/coordinate agreement.
